test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at speeds of 100 km/hr and 140 km/hr. The length of one train is 490 m. The time taken by them to cross each other is 22 seconds. The length (in m) of the other train, rounded off to 2 decimal places, is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Train 1 = 100 km/hr

Speed of Train 2 = 140 km/hr

Length of Train 1 = 490 m

Time taken to cross each other = 22 seconds

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2 (since they are moving in opposite directions)

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

Distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2
